title: EVEREST: K2 light curves corrected for the spacecraft's pointing, at MAST

links.label: EVEREST: K2 light curves corrected for the spacecraft's pointing, at MAST

evidence.locator: DataCite record of the DOI: EPIC Variability Extraction and Removal for Exoplanet Science Targets ("EVEREST"), R. Luger, STScI/MAST, 2016. An open-source pipeline that removes instrumental systematics from K2 light curves by pixel-level decorrelation of the spacecraft's pointing error, with Gaussian processes for the star's own variability (Luger et al. 2016, AJ 152, 100; version 2, Luger et al. 2018, AJ 156, 99). A file holds one target's light curve of a campaign.

statements.text: This work includes data collected by the K2 mission, funded by the NASA Science Mission Directorate, obtained from the Mikulski Archive for Space Telescopes (MAST).
